toggle.label: Share this run
toggle.hint: Your run is visible at your link while you record, and stops the moment you save or discard it. Not a safety device: never rely on it for help.

link.hint: Anyone with this link can follow the runs you share, no account needed. It is the same link every time, and shows nothing in between. Replace it any time to cut off everyone who has it.
link.createBody: You get one link, and it stays the same for every run you share. Anyone you send it to can follow those runs while you record, with no account. They see nothing between runs, and nothing about you. Replace the link any time to cut off everyone who has it.
link.replaceBody: Your current link stops working for everyone you have sent it to. You will get a new one to share.
link.unconfirmed: Could not check your link just now. Reconnect before sending it.
link.failed: Could not reach your link. Check your connection and try again.
link.unavailable: Sharing by link is not available right now. Your run is still shared with your own devices.
link.limit: You have replaced this link many times. Get in touch if you need a new one.
link.settingsDesc: The link people use to follow your runs while you record. Replacing it stops the current one working for everyone you have sent it to.

watch.title: Live run
